items.headline: U.S. Stocks Rebound, Snap Four-Day Losing Streak Amid Easing Oil Prices and CPI Data
items.summary: U.S. equity markets closed higher on Friday, September 11, 2026, breaking a four-session losing streak. The rally was driven by a retreat in crude oil prices and an August inflation report that largely met economists' expectations, despite underlying inflation remaining firm. Expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike next week strengthened. Not financial advice.

items.headline: ACXP Surges on Strong Performance
items.summary: ACXP was a standout gainer, surging over 83% on the day.

items.headline: Dell Technologies Rises on AI Cloud Optimism
items.summary: Dell Technologies saw an 11.46% increase, fueled by investor reassurance regarding data-center spending following Oracle's strong earnings report and accelerating demand for AI servers.

items.headline: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Climbs on Data-Center Demand
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise gained 10.75% as Oracle's earnings bolstered confidence in data-center spending and highlighted HPE's strength in networking and enterprise infrastructure.

items.headline: ACV Auctions Soars on Acquisition News
items.summary: ACV Auctions soared 44.2% after Copart announced its intent to acquire the company for $10.50 per share.

items.headline: MiNK Therapeutics Leads Decliners
items.summary: MiNK Therapeutics experienced a significant decline of 15.54%, attributed to heavy volume and potential factors such as an earnings miss, downgrade, or sector rotation.

items.headline: Intel Drops Amid Sector Rotation
items.summary: Intel saw a 5.57% decline, indicating outflows from the broader semiconductor space and increased bearish sentiment.

items.headline: Oracle's Early Gains Fade Despite Strong Report
items.summary: Oracle's stock finished down 1.7%, reversing an early jump, despite reporting stronger-than-expected profit and revenue for its latest quarter.

items.headline: Copart Declines After Acquisition Announcement
items.summary: Copart shares fell 2.6% following its announcement to acquire ACV Auctions.

items.headline: Healthcare and Communication Services Lead Sector Gains
items.summary: Sector rotation on Friday favored Healthcare, which surged 2.26%, and Consumer Cyclical, up 2.14%. Communication Services also performed strongly, gaining 1.35%. Conversely, Utilities lagged, facing the largest drawdown, while Energy declined 0.63%, and Technology saw a modest decline of 0.27%.

items.headline: August CPI Report Matches Expectations, Core Inflation Higher
items.summary: The August Consumer Price Index (CPI) increased 0.4% month-over-month, aligning with economists' forecasts, bringing the annual inflation rate to 3.4%. Core CPI, excluding volatile food and energy prices, rose 0.3% for the month, slightly above the 0.2% consensus, with an annual rate of 2.4%. This data, coupled with falling oil prices, helped calm market anxieties.

items.headline: Fed Rate Hike 'All But Assured' Next Week Amid Persistent Inflation
items.summary: Expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike next week have significantly strengthened following the August CPI report and elevated oil prices. Markets are now pricing in a greater than 85% chance of a Fed rate increase, as inflation remains above the Fed's long-term target. The 10-year Treasury yield also climbed to nearly 5%, nearing a three-year high.

items.headline: Oil Prices Retreat, Alleviating Inflationary Pressure
items.summary: Brent crude oil prices fell nearly 3% to settle at $104.61 per barrel, easing from recent highs that had approached $110 overnight. This decline in oil prices provided significant relief to the market, mitigating some inflationary pressures and contributing to the day's equity rebound.
